description: Fire a synthetic sample 'incoming_message' envelope (flagged test:true) at the registered webhook URL — or at an override `url` passed here — and return the delivery result: { delivered, statusCode, durationMs, responsePreview }. Use this to confirm your endpoint actually receives Gambot's calls. The attempt is recorded in the delivery log.

authHeader.description: Optional Authorization header to send with the override URL test.

url.description: Optional override URL to test instead of the registered one (lets you test before registering).

name: gambot_test_webhook
title: Send a test webhook event
